name: Mighty Chipmunk 64
author: Web-Potato
description: Dark green button that fades on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, opacity becomes 0, transform becomes scale(0.7,0.7), opacity becomes 1.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Mighty Chipmunk 64</title>
<style>
/* Mighty Chipmunk 64 by Web-Potato — https://uiverse.io/Web-Potato/mighty-chipmunk-64 */
button {
  position: relative;
  height: 50px;
  width: 150px;
  color: #FFF;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  background-color: #212121;
  transition: all 0.5s;
  border: none;
}

button::before {
  position: absolute;
  content: '';
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: rgba(29, 255, 86, 0.281);
  border-radius: 5px;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  z-index: 1;
}

button:hover::before {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.7,0.7);
}

button::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  transition: all 0.4s;
  border: 1px solid rgba(29, 255, 86, 0.281);
  border-radius: 5px;
  transform: scale(1.5,1.5);
  opacity: 0;
  z-index: 1;
}

button:hover::after {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1,1);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
